name: api-migrator
description: API Migration Campaigns as a Service — find affected customer code, deliver tested, reviewable migration pull requests.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:console
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @api-migrator/engine && npm run build --workspace @api-migrator/db && npm run build --workspace @api-migrator/app && npm run build --workspace @api-migrator/runner
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test:workspaces
scripts.test:ops: npm run test:ops:shell && npm run test:ops:gateway && npm run test:ops:deployment && npm run test:ops:image
scripts.ci: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:workspaces && npm run test:workspaces && npm run test:pilot && npm run test:ops && npm run pilot:validate -- docs/pilot/pilot-result.example.json && npm run build:console
